name: Six Feet Under

features.name: Dirt layers
features.description: Bottom rows fill with dirt that can hide gems.

features.name: Bomb types
features.description: Each bomb clears its own pattern.

review:
A 6x6 graveyard where the bottom rows fill with dirt at random each spin – and some of that dirt hides gems with cash values. Several types of bomb clear symbols and dirt in their own patterns, and digging deeper uncovers more gems.

A twist on the Fire in the Hole digging idea, with more focus on collecting. Extreme volatility, 30,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
